publication.title: A Titanosaurian Sauropod with South American Affinities (Lognkosauria: Argentinosauridae) from the Late Maastrichtian of Morocco and Evidence for Dinosaur Endemism in Africa
authors: V. Díez Díaz, X. Pereda-Suberbiola, N. Bardet, N. Jalil

locality.name: PBDB collection 230233: Office Chérifien des Phosphates mines at Sidi Chennane, Khouribga Province, Morocco

age.basis: PBDB assigns collection 230233 to Late Maastrichtian with numeric bounds 72.2–66 Ma.
age.notes: Database-derived occurrence snapshot from Paleobiology Database reference 94682; not yet re-verified against the publication full text.

claims.summary: PBDB occurrence 2063689 records Phosphatotitan khouribgaensis in collection 230233, linked by PBDB to reference 94682.
PBDB stores the original/identified name as Phosphatotitan khouribgaensis n. gen. n. sp. and the accepted name as Phosphatotitan khouribgaensis.
